notes:
The first release of the mirror app as a signed payload of its own. Hosts on
`self_update = true` install it on their next full pass; a `"canary"` host installs it the
moment this release's ping arrives. A host still on `false` keeps running its rsynced
checkout and is unaffected.

#### Added
- The app installs its own releases. `installSelf` verifies this manifest against the
  release ring pinned in `trust.ts`, stages the files under `state/releases/<serial>/` and
  stands down; `boot.ts` runs whichever release `state/current` names. One that cannot stay
  up three times running is marked bad and backed out.
- A per-client transfer cap, so one client cannot spend the month's budget: `client_cap`
  times what this host carries, per rolling `client_window`. IPv4 per address, IPv6 per /64.
- `mirrors` and `mirrorapp` pings are answered by every host, whatever its `payloads` lists.

#### Changed
- The server answers exactly the five paths sync writes and 404s everything else, so the
  lock file, the transfer counter and anything else in the root are no longer downloadable.
- The release key ring is pinned in the app rather than fetched at ping time.
- Read tokens are one per private repo: `[tokens.read]` with an entry per repo.
- The systemd unit sandboxes the service and its start limit is finally parsed.

#### Fixed
- A request whose Host is not a host no longer reaches Bun's development error page, which
  disclosed the install path and a source excerpt.
- The server refuses to start if the tree it serves contains `mirror.cfg`, the working
  directory's `.env`, or the app itself.
- A pinged pass now commits a release it can see that is newer than the tree, instead of
  discarding it while it waits for the serial it was told about.
- The token-table migration message no longer prints the token it is migrating.
